dailyTips.title: Drink a Glass of Water Upon Waking
dailyTips.detail: Starts your metabolism, lubricates joints, and boosts morning energy level naturally.

dailyTips.title: Include Protein in Every Meal
dailyTips.detail: Aim for a palm-sized portion of protein (eggs, Greek yogurt, chicken, fish, lentils, or tofu) to protect joint & muscle strength.

dailyTips.title: Calcium & Vitamin D Boost
dailyTips.detail: Support bone density with leafy greens, almonds, fortified milk, sesame seeds, and 10 minutes of gentle sunlight.

dailyTips.title: Fiber-Rich Whole Foods
dailyTips.detail: Oats, berries, quinoa, and vegetables keep blood sugar steady and support digestion naturally.

mealIdeas.title: Warm Protein Oatmeal
mealIdeas.description: Rolled oats topped with chia seeds, sliced banana, a handful of walnuts, and a splash of milk or Greek yogurt.

mealIdeas.title: Rainbow Protein Salad or Bowl
mealIdeas.description: Mixed greens, grilled chicken or chickpea salad, cucumber, tomatoes, olive oil dressing, and whole wheat toast.

mealIdeas.title: Handful of Almonds & Apple
mealIdeas.description: Crisp apple slices with 10-12 raw almonds or peanut butter for lasting afternoon energy.

mealIdeas.title: Baked Salmon / Tofu & Steamed Veggies
mealIdeas.description: Herb-baked salmon or marinated tofu served with steamed broccoli, carrots, and sweet potato mash.
